description: Test-set (2023-2024) performance by model, stage, domain
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity; train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: Weighted (WEIGHT) and unweighted metrics; 95% percentile CIs from 200 Rao-Wu rescaled bootstrap replicates of PSU_VAR within PSUSTRAT (seed config.RANDOM_SEED)
